messages.author: 2d672dbe9a25ad54
messages.subject: Request for explanation
parts:
Hello Dear,
Good morning. I am a graduate student at Niigata University, Japan. I used lavaan package (0.6-3) for sem analysis of my data.

I have 3 layers of variables in my analytical framework.

Layer 1: x1, x2, x3, x4, x5,x6,x7
Layer 2: y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7
Layer 3: z1, z2, z3,z4

My analytical equations are:
z1~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
z2~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
z3~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
z4~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7

y1~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
y2~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
y3~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
y4~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
y5~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
y6~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7
y7~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+x7

z1~y1+y2+y3+y4+y5+y6+y7
z2~y1+y2+y3+y4+y5+y6+y7
z3~y1+y2+y3+y4+y5+y6+y7
z4~y1+y2+y3+y4+y5+y6+y7

I used the following code: 
fit <-lavaan:::cfa(model.Lavaan, data=stand.d, std.lv=TRUE, fixed.x=FALSE)
summary(fit)
summary(fit,fit.measures=TRUE,standardized=TRUE,modindices=TRUE)

It calculates the covariances among the variables within layer-1 and layer-3. But it does not calculate covariances among layer-2.
Now, my question is how I can calculate covariances among the variables within layer-2?

Please help me in this regard.
Best wishes,
RANA Sohel

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Request for explanation
parts:
It calculates the covariances among the variables within layer-1 and layer-3. But it does not calculate covariances among layer-2. 
Now, my question is how I can calculate covariances among the variables within layer-2?

You mean "estimate", not "calculate".  For variables that are both predictors and outcomes (i.e., mediators), you must manually specify the residual covariances you want to estimate in your model syntax.

y1 ~~ y2+y3+y4+y5+y6+y7
y2 ~~ y3+y4+y5+y6+y7
...
y6 ~~ y7
